versions.changelog:
Initial release of MCP Orchestral – advanced multi-agent orchestration for the Super-Skill ecosystem.

- Integrates the MCP Server with 27–28 specialized Super-Agents for orchestrated AI workflows.
- Includes DeepMaster-Agent, Flowise workflow integration, MongoDB management, and multi-agent coordination.
- Provides example code for core integrations and orchestration workflows.
- Supports dynamic agent creation, multi-agent scaling, and synergy computation between agents.
- Lists detailed agent roles across cognition, data, communication, media, and infrastructure.
- Enables seamless integration with the Super-Skill platform for expanded orchestration capabilities.
